event_summary: At mission time T+04:17:32, Asteria-7 recorded an 8.7-sigma spectrometer transient lasting approximately 1.8 seconds during the Europa flyby science pass. The event is concurrent with a 41% increase in radiation counter readings, a 0.8°C instrument temperature rise, and 2 packet checksum errors. The spacecraft was operating in HIGH compression mode, activated 102 seconds before the event. No single hypothesis fully explains the combined sensor pattern.

hypotheses.name: Packet corruption or data transmission error

preservation_priorities.reason: Primary instrument data. Preserves the temporal and spectral shape of the transient required by all three investigative paths. Averaging or compression will destroy asymmetry and secondary pulse structure referenced in SPECTROMETER-MANUAL §3.2.
supports_hypotheses: Packet corruption or data transmission error
preservation_priorities.consequence_if_lost: Investigators cannot perform spectral analysis of the event. All three hypotheses become untestable from direct measurement.

preservation_priorities.reason: Required to test the external radiation hypothesis and to contradict the fault hypothesis. Temporal resolution must be preserved to establish cross-sensor correlation with the spectrometer. Averaging destroys the sub-second timing referenced in RADIATION-EVENTS §3.1.
preservation_priorities.consequence_if_lost: Cannot confirm or rule out an external particle event. The most scientifically significant hypothesis becomes permanently untestable.

preservation_priorities.reason: Small but irreplaceable. Determines whether measured anomalies are real or data corruption artifacts. The two observed checksum errors near the event must be assessed against specific packet boundaries. PACKET-INTEGRITY §3.5 notes this log cannot be reconstructed.
supports_hypotheses: Packet corruption or data transmission error
preservation_priorities.consequence_if_lost: Cannot rule out data corruption as the source of the anomaly. The entire investigation may be built on corrupted measurements.

preservation_priorities.reason: Tests the electronics fault hypothesis. The 0.8°C temperature rise is within the range that can produce gain shifts in the spectrometer array per SPECTROMETER-MANUAL §5.7. Required to assess whether the transient is a thermal artifact.
preservation_priorities.consequence_if_lost: Cannot assess thermal contribution to the measured transient. Electronics fault hypothesis remains neither confirmed nor excluded.

preservation_priorities.reason: Bus voltage change is nominal (0.3%) which slightly argues against a power-induced fault. Useful corroborating evidence but not essential if bandwidth is exhausted.
preservation_priorities.consequence_if_lost: Lose one corroborating data point for fault analysis. Acceptable loss if budget requires it.

preservation_priorities.reason: Provides environmental context but no direct evidence for any hypothesis. The thumbnail is the largest evidence item and contributes least to distinguishing between the three explanations. Should be deprioritized under bandwidth constraints.
preservation_priorities.consequence_if_lost: Lose visual environmental context. Does not affect the ability to test any of the three primary hypotheses.

recommended_follow_up: Schedule a repeat spectrometer observation during a quieter magnetospheric phase with compression mode set to LOW and all correlated instruments recording at maximum sample rate. Cross-reference with Europa magnetospheric models for the flyby geometry at T+04:17:32.
compression_warning: HIGH compression mode was active during the event. The raw spectrum and radiation window must not be re-compressed before transmission. Applying additional compression to already-compressed data risks cascading information loss. The packet integrity log must be transmitted without any summarization — the error count alone is insufficient for investigation.
uncertainty_statement: This event cannot be conclusively classified with the available summary telemetry. All three hypotheses — external radiation event, electronics fault, and data corruption — remain viable. The evidence capsule is constructed to preserve the investigative capacity to test each explanation independently. Do not treat any hypothesis as confirmed.
